text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Switching to rest mode. Resuming training once fully recharged.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: This is Mihono Bourbon patrolling the skies. Giant robot rampaging through town sighted. Engaging.

text_block_list.name: Giant Robot
text_block_list.text: ROOOOARGH! DAUUUGHTER!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …! Voice pattern confirmed… It bears a strong resemblance to my father's. How can this be?

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Robo-Father (?)
text_block_list.text: ZRRRT… I WILL FLATTEN THIS CITY AND CONSTRUCT A SPACIOUS TRAINING FIELD!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I request that you halt, Robo-Father. The flattening of this city would cause great distress to everyone who resides here.

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Robo-Father (?)
text_block_list.text: DAUGHTER! I AM WORRIED! ARE YOU TRULY IN AN ENVIRONMENT WHERE YOU CAN DEVELOP?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …Personality inconsistent with my true father. Rampage identified as the result of an error in the robot's programming.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Don't worry, Father.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: You taught me the importance of hard work.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: And my master believes in my ability to grow.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I will become stronger here. Have faith in us and just watch.

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Robo-Father (?)
text_block_list.text: IS THAT SO? I'M GLAD TO HEAR THAT. ALSO, DON'T FORGET TO CALL US ONCE IN A WHILE, OKAY?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Understood.

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Robo-Father
text_block_list.text: NO, YOU DON'T NEED TO UNDERSTAND. I AM SPEAKING TO THE REAL BOURBON WITHIN YOU.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …Huh? Another me?
Beep, kzzzt… Deploying cockpit monitor.

text_block_list.name: Real Mihono Bourbon (?)
text_block_list.text: Ta-daaah… Hello, there. I'm the one who pilots Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Real Mihono Bourbon (?)
text_block_list.text: It's already nighttime. You better wake up.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: P-pilot? Is there someone controlling me?
Caught up in the events of her dream, Bourbon doesn't get much rest.
